Company Description
In the fast-growing economies of the world, there's a new generation of ambitious younger people eager to gain financial independence and we’re here to make this potential a reality by empowering them with the Freedom to Succeed.
We empower them with guidance, tools, and easy market access so they can trade and invest with confidence. We aim to make our clients their own wealth manager: empowered to create investment strategies and make investment decisions effortlessly, in their own time, on their own terms, in their own way.
Founded in 1998 to offer online trading for retail clients, the Exinity Group is now over 25 years old and has provided leveraged trading to over 2 million customers through our global power brands, including FXTM and Nemo, giving them access to equity, commodity and FX markets across the Middle East, Asia, and Africa.
Exinity is an energetic and diverse company with central offices in the UAE, Cyprus and the UK, plus a number of smaller hubs globally. We’re always looking for talented individuals to join us. ‘Freedom to Succeed’ is not just a promise we make to our clients and partners, but to our people too. We’ll help you develop a range of skills, take on early responsibility, and enjoy a rewarding and fulfilling career with a fast-growing, dynamic company.

Job Description
We are looking for a data-driven and hands-on Paid Social Media Specialist to join our Acquisition Marketing team.
In this role, you will be responsible for planning, launching, managing, and optimizing paid social campaigns across major platforms including Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, and other relevant social channels. You will work closely with creative, analytics, product, and Commercial Marketing teams to drive customer acquisition, improve campaign efficiency, and scale growth across multiple markets.
This is a highly execution-focused role, ideal for someone with a strong performance marketing mindset and at least 2 years of hands-on experience managing paid social campaigns.
What You'll Do
•
Plan, execute, and optimize paid social campaigns across platforms such as Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, Snapchat, and other emerging channels.
•
Manage campaign setup, budget allocation, audience targeting, bidding strategies, and performance monitoring.
•
Analyze campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve CPA, CAC, ROAS, conversion rates, and overall marketing efficiency.
•
Conduct audience testing, creative testing, and landing page optimization to maximize campaign results.
•
Collaborate with designers, content creators, and product marketers to develop high-performing ad creatives and messaging.
•
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and platform updates to identify new growth opportunities.
•
Generate regular performance reports and provide actionable insights to stakeholders.
•
Work closely with analytics and CRM teams to ensure accurate tracking, attribution, and measurement.
•
Support regional acquisition initiatives and contribute to broader growth marketing projects.

Qualifications
Must Have
•
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field.
•
Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience managing paid social campaigns and budgets, including proven experience with Meta Ads Manager and at least one additional platform (TikTok, LinkedIn, X, Snapchat, etc.).
•
Deep understanding of paid social advertising and digital marketing funnels, with strong awareness of the latest platform trends, ad formats, algorithm changes, and best practices.
•
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze user behavior across the funnel using Excel, Google Sheets, GA4, or similar tools, and turn insights into actions that improve performance against business KPIs.
•
Strong audience strategy skills, including identifying, building, and scaling target audiences (e.g., custom audiences, lookalikes, interest-based, and broad targeting).
•
Ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities in a fast-paced environment, with strong attention to detail and excellent communication skills in English.
•
Reading and writing proficiency in both Traditional and Simplified Chinese running campaigns in both languages
Nice to Have
•
Experience in the FX/online trading, fintech, financial services, or gaming industries.
•
Familiarity with attribution tools such as AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch, or similar platforms.
•
Working knowledge of SQL, BI tools, or marketing automation platforms.
•
Experience running multi-region or international campaigns.
•
Basic understanding of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, or Gemini for marketing productivity and campaign analysis.
•
Hands-on experience integrating AI into daily campaign optimization workflows, such as performance analysis, creative testing, and reporting automation.

Who we are

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your Mission

As the Business Operations Specialist, you will be the operational engine behind Bitpanda's rapidly growing Securities & Commodities business line. You will ensure daily business operations run flawlessly, manage critical external partnerships, and drive the seamless launch of major new investment products. Operating within a fast-paced, startup-like environment, your work will directly impact product launches, customer experience, and company revenue.

What you'll do

• Run operational processes end-to-end, monitoring recurring tasks like instrument listings/delistings, data and venue usage reporting, partner billing, and operational follow-ups on reconciliations.

• Manage operational partners and vendors hands-on, acting as the day-to-day contact for SLAs, incidents, invoices, and service reviews.

• Deliver projects and launches by planning cross-team initiatives and owning launch readiness, including operational processes, Customer Support enablement, Compliance and Legal sign-offs and go-live checklists. Act as project manager for larger launches when needed.

• Improve and automate processes by building runbooks, removing manual steps, and utilizing tooling or AI to reduce errors.

• Create operational transparency by tracking data on volumes, incidents, and partner performance to flag trends before they become critical issues.

Who you are

• You have 3+ years of experience in business operations or operational project management in financial services, for example at a broker, bank, fintech or exchange. Consulting counts if it was hands-on delivery.

• You have a proven track record of delivering cross-functional projects end-to-end, including managing milestones, risks, and go/no-go launch decisions.

• You are highly capable of managing external partners and vendors hands-on, including SLAs, escalations, invoices and contract follow-ups.

• You understand how a trade flows from order to execution, settlement and custody, and what corporate actions and reconciliation involve.

• You are strong with data and spreadsheets, check numbers yourself, and like to document and improve processes.

• You have experience working in a regulated environment, understanding when and how to secure Compliance and Legal sign-offs, and you possess excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

What’s in it for you

• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.

• Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.

• Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.

• Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.

• Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.

• Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.

• Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.

• Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.

• Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.

• Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.

• Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

.…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

岗位概述

我们正处于 AI 重塑金融基础设施的历史节点。作为 AI Agent 架构师，你将成为 AI 智能体系的核心构建者——不只是编写代码，而是定义下一代金融级 Agent 如何感知市场信号、规划执行路径、记忆业务上下文与跨系统协作。你将主导打造可承载真实金融场景的 Agent 体系，覆盖交易辅助、风控研判、合规监察、用户智能服务等核心业务，让 AI 在加密金融的高速、高压、高合规环境中真正自主完成复杂任务。这里没有边界模糊的分工，有的是直接影响亿级用户体验的技术决策权，以及一支对 LLM 与 Agent 技术有极高密度认知的精英工程团队。

核心职责

•

Agent 体系架构设计：主导设计 AI 智能体架构，定义 Agent 在 Openclaw 平台上的运行模型、生命周期管理与资源隔离策略；构建支撑交易辅助、风控研判、合规监察等金融核心场景的 Agent 能力基座，确保系统在高并发、低延迟、强合规约束下稳定运行。

•

金融场景 Agent 工程化落地：将交易信号分析、风险识别、监管合规、智能客服等业务需求转化为可执行的 Agent 工作流；设计任务规划链路（ReAct / Plan-and-Execute）、异常回退机制与结果验证体系，推动 Agent 从 PoC 快速进入生产环境。

•

Openclaw 平台建设与演进：深度参与 Openclaw Agent Runtime 的架构演进与性能优化；设计插件体系、能力注册中心与多 Agent 编排机制，降低业务团队接入成本，持续提升平台的扩展性与复用率。

•

工具生态与内部系统集成：构建标准化工具调用框架，打通 Bybit 内部交易引擎、风控系统、数据平台与外部 API；设计工具权限管控、调用链追踪与错误恢复机制，集成 MCP 等标准协议，构建金融级异构工具生态。

•

生产质量与可观测性体系：主导 Agent 系统的可观测性建设，包括 Trace 追踪、Evaluation 评测、成本监控与延迟治理；建立金融场景下的 Agent 质量基线与回归测试体系，持续提升系统稳定性与可解释性。

•

技术前瞻与团队赋能：持续追踪 Agent 领域前沿进展，将研究成果转化为 AI 工程实践；制定团队 Agent 开发规范与最佳实践，通过 Code Review、技术分享与方向评审推动团队整体 AI-native 工程能力提升。

任职要求

扎实的 LLM/Agent 工程经验：具备 3年以上 AI 系统开发经验，其中 1年以上 大型语言模型（LLM）、RAG 或 Agent 系统的生产环境落地经验；具备 Openclaw 平台的开发与优化实战经验，熟悉其 Agent Runtime 架构、插件体系与多 Agent 编排机制，能基于 Openclaw 独立完成复杂 Agent 应用的工程化落地与性能调优。

•

系统架构能力：具备分布式系统设计能力，熟悉微服务架构、消息队列（Kafka / RabbitMQ）、异步任务调度等工程模式；能够独立完成从需求分析、架构设计到技术选型的完整决策链路。

•

编程能力：熟悉至少一门后端语言（Golang / Java / Node.js）；具备 REST API 设计与 Docker / Kubernetes 容器化部署能力。

LLM 核心技术理解：深入理解 Transformer 架构、Attention 机制、Prompt Engineering（CoT、Few-shot、Structured Output）；熟悉主流模型 API（OpenAI、Anthropic Claude、Google Gemini）及本地部署方案（Ollama、vLLM）。

工程质量意识：具备良好的代码设计习惯（设计模式、单元测试、CI/CD）；有构建 LLM 评测（Evaluation）体系或 Agent Tracing（LangSmith / Phoenix / Langfuse）的实战经验。

在 金融、Web3、合规 或其他高复杂度垂直领域有 Agent 系统落地经验，理解领域知识对 Agent 设计的特殊约束。

有开源贡献或在 NeurIPS / ICML / ACL / ICLR 等顶会发表过 Agent / RAG / LLM 相关论文。

熟悉 MCP（Model Context Protocol） 或参与过 Agent 标准协议的设计与实现。

About the Role

We're at an inflection point where AI is fundamentally reshaping financial infrastructure. As an AI Agent Architect, you will be a core builder of AI's intelligent ecosystem — not just writing code, but defining how next-generation financial-grade Agents perceive market signals, plan execution paths, retain business context, and orchestrate across systems. You will lead the construction of Agent capabilities purpose-built for real financial scenarios: trading intelligence, risk assessment, compliance monitoring, and smart user services — engineered to operate autonomously in crypto finance's high-velocity, high-stakes, and high-compliance environment.This is a role with genuine technical ownership. You'll make architectural decisions that directly shape the experience of hundreds of millions of users, alongside an elite engineering team with exceptional depth in LLM and Agent technology.

Key Responsibilities

•

Agent Architecture Design: Lead the architectural design of AI's intelligent Agent layer — defining agent execution models, lifecycle management, and resource isolation strategies on the Openclaw platform. Build the foundational Agent capabilities powering core financial scenarios including trading intelligence, risk assessment, and compliance monitoring, engineered for high-concurrency, low-latency, and regulatory-grade reliability.

•

Financial Scenario Agent Engineering: Translate complex financial use cases — trading signal analysis, risk identification, regulatory compliance, and intelligent customer service — into production-ready Agent workflows. Design task planning chains (ReAct / Plan-and-Execute), fallback and error recovery mechanisms, and result validation frameworks that accelerate the path from PoC to production.

•

Openclaw Platform Development & Evolution: Contribute deeply to the architectural evolution and performance optimization of the Openclaw Agent Runtime. Design the plugin ecosystem, capability registry, and multi-agent orchestration mechanisms to reduce onboarding friction for product teams and improve platform extensibility and reusability.

•

Tool Ecosystem & Internal System Integration: Build a standardized tool-calling framework connecting Bybit's internal trading engine, risk systems, data platforms, and external APIs. Design tool permission controls, call-chain tracing, and error recovery; integrate standards such as MCP to unify a financial-grade heterogeneous tool ecosystem.

•

Production Quality & Observability: Lead the observability stack for Agent systems, including trace monitoring, evaluation pipelines, cost tracking, and latency governance. Establish quality baselines and regression testing frameworks for financial Agent scenarios, continuously improving system stability and interpretability.

•

Technical Vision & Team Enablement: Track and internalize cutting-edge Agent research, translating advances into AI engineering practice. Define team-wide Agent development standards and best practices; drive AI-native engineering capability uplift through code reviews, technical sharing, and architectural reviews.

Requirements

•

Proven LLM / Agent Engineering Experience: 3+ years of AI systems development experience, including 1+ year of production experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG systems, or Agent frameworks; hands-on development and optimization experience with Openclaw, including familiarity with its Agent Runtime architecture, plugin ecosystem, and multi-agent orchestration mechanisms.

•

Systems Architecture Proficiency: Strong distributed systems design skills including microservices architecture, message queues (Kafka / RabbitMQ), and async task scheduling; capable of independently driving the full decision chain from requirements analysis through architecture design to technology selection.

•

Programming Expertise: Proficiency in at least one backend language (Golang / Java / Node.js); solid REST API design and containerized deployment skills (Docker / Kubernetes).

•

Deep LLM Technical Understanding: Strong grasp of Transformer architecture, Attention mechanisms, and advanced Prompt Engineering (CoT, Few-shot, Structured Output); experience with major model APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini) and local deployment solutions (Ollama, vLLM).

•

Engineering Quality Standards: Strong software design fundamentals (design patterns, unit testing, CI/CD); hands-on experience building LLM evaluation frameworks or Agent tracing pipelines (LangSmith / Phoenix / Langfuse).

Nice to Have

•

Experience combining MCTS, A\*, or Reinforcement Learning (RL) with LLMs for planning and reasoning; familiarity with SFT / RLHF training pipelines.

•

Proven Agent system deployments in high-complexity vertical domains such as Finance, Web3, or Compliance, with an understanding of domain-specific constraints on Agent design.

•

Open-source contributions or publications in NeurIPS / ICML / ACL / ICLR on Agent, RAG, or LLM-related topics.

•

Experience with multimodal Agent development, including vision-language understanding and unstructured document parsing (PDFs, financial reports, research papers).

•

Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or prior involvement in designing and implementing Agent communication standards.

Crypto.com is a global cryptocurrency platform serving traders and investors in markets around the world. The CDC product line is our international crypto trading app — spanning spot, perpetual contracts, and card rips — and we are building the next generation of trading products for a global audience.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Growth to sit at the intersection of user acquisition, creative strategy, martech, and measurement. This is not a single-lane role. You’ll own the day-to-day performance of our UA program across paid channels and every market we operate in, but you’ll also lead three critical sub-functions — creative, martech, and measurement — that today sit with senior leadership and need a dedicated operator to take them to the next level.

You’ll work directly with our agency partners, product teams, data science, and platform reps (Meta, Google, Apple) across regions. You’ll inherit a scaled UA program with multiple products launching simultaneously, a global market footprint, and a martech stack that’s being built in real time. If you’re the kind of person who can context-switch between a Meta CAPI payload spec and a creative brief in the same afternoon, this role was made for you.

Responsibilities 
User Acquisition Operations

• Own the weekly operating rhythm for CDC paid UA — spend plans, pacing, optimization decisions, and performance reporting across all channels (Meta, Google, Apple Search, programmatic DSPs, affiliates, regional platforms, and emerging networks), across every market we operate in

• Manage the relationship with our performance agency on a daily basis — standups, creative briefings, channel strategy, spend allocation, and trading decisions

• Drive channel-level optimization using CAC, CPFT, pLTV ROAS, and lower-funnel conversion metrics. You’re expected to know what’s working, what’s not, and why before anyone asks

• Lead GTM execution for new product launches and market openings (spot, perpetual contracts, card rips, new offer structures) — from tracking readiness through creative production through spend activation

• Build and maintain the weekly trading deck and leadership updates. Present performance narratives to VP and C-level stakeholders with clarity and confidence

• Own the competitive monitoring cadence — Sensor Tower, app store rankings, ad intelligence — across key markets, and translate competitive signals into channel and creative decisions

• Own market prioritisation — which countries we open, in what order, and what each market needs in localisation, payment rails, and channel mix before we commit spend

Sub-function: Creative Strategy

Our creative pipeline is currently managed between agency and leadership. This role takes ownership of the full creative lifecycle for performance marketing.

• Own the creative learning agenda — what hooks, formats, and concepts we’re testing, what’s winning, and what to kill. Maintain a structured view of creative performance by channel, format, and audience

• Lead creative briefing for the agency and UGC creators. Translate product updates, offers, and cultural moments into production-ready briefs with clear deliverables and timelines, localised for each market we run in

• Drive format expansion beyond static display — UGC video, social-native content, meme-format creative, and AI-assisted production pipelines

• Establish a rapid refresh cadence to combat creative fatigue across channels, and ensure channel-specific sizing and placement specs are met

• Coordinate with brand and content teams on production shoots, scripting, and asset capture for UA use

Sub-function: Martech

Our martech stack spans AppsFlyer, Segment, Firebase, Google Tag Manager, Meta CAPI, Impact (affiliates), and multiple ad platform integrations. Today this is led by our VP with execution support from a solo martech lead. This role becomes the strategic owner.

• Serve as the growth team’s primary point of contact for all tracking, attribution, and signal infrastructure. You’re the person who knows whether events are firing, payloads are complete, and platform signals are flowing

• Partner with our martech lead to prioritize and unblock implementation work — new product event instrumentation, platform pixel/CAPI builds, conversion upload pipelines, and deep link configuration

• Own the relationship with platform measurement teams (Google gTech, Meta measurement partners, AppsFlyer TAMs) across regions and ensure their recommendations translate into shipped work

• Drive martech readiness for every product launch and offer change. If tracking isn’t ready, you’re the one who flags it and owns the escalation

• Understand the full signal chain from user action to ad platform optimization loop — SDK events, server-to-server integrations, CAPI payloads, consent parameters, and AEM eligibility requirements

• Handle the multi-market layer — regional MMP configuration, multi-currency revenue handling, and market-specific consent and privacy regimes

Sub-function: Measurement

Measurement maturity is the constraint on scaling. This role owns the roadmap for closing attribution gaps and building toward incrementality-based decision-making.

• Own the attribution framework — last-click, MECE logic, promo code overlap rules — and ensure it’s consistently applied across reporting, agency data, and leadership updates

• Define and maintain measurement plans for each product line (spot, perps, rips) including KPI definitions, LTV attribution windows, and what “success” looks like at each funnel stage

• Lead the build-out of conversion feedback loops for each platform — Google Ads click ID upload pipelines, Meta CAPI integration, and Apple SKAN/AdAttributionKit readiness

• Partner with data science on pLTV model validation, cohort economics tracking, and the eventual transition from CPA to ROAS-based bidding

• Scope and prioritize incrementality testing (geo holdouts, per-channel lift measurement) and marketing mix modeling as the program matures

• Maintain reporting credibility — when agency data and Tableau data don’t match, you’re the person who investigates, explains, and fixes it

• Normalise reporting across currencies and markets so performance is comparable country to country, and so a CAC in one region means the same thing as a CAC in another

Requirements: 
• 5+ years in performance marketing or growth, with direct ownership of paid UA budgets across Meta, Google, Apple Search, and at least one programmatic partner

• Hands-on experience with mobile measurement partners (AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Branch), server-to-server integrations, and ad platform conversion APIs (Meta CAPI, Google Ads S2S)

• Experience marketing trading or investing products — you understand funding rates, spreads, deposit and withdrawal flows, and why an active trader’s value profile looks different from a casual user’s

• Track record running paid UA across multiple international markets — localisation, regional channel mix, a multi-time-zone operating rhythm, and market-by-market regulatory nuance

• Strong working knowledge of attribution models, SKAN/AdAttributionKit, AEM eligibility, and the privacy-era signal landscape

• Experience managing or closely partnering with a performance creative function — you’ve briefed UGC creators, reviewed ad concepts, and made data-backed creative decisions

• Comfort with ambiguity and competing priorities. You’ll be launching multiple products, fixing attribution gaps, and building new measurement infrastructure simultaneously

• Exceptional communication skills — you can explain a CAPI payload issue to an engineer and a CAC trend to a CMO in the same day

• Experience in crypto, trading, fintech, or financial services is strongly preferred — you’ve marketed a product where the user is putting capital at risk. What matters most is that you’ve scaled paid UA in a high-velocity, multi-product environment

Why This Role: 
• You’re joining at an inflection point — new products launching, measurement stack being built, creative pipeline evolving. The person in this seat will shape how all of it comes together

• You’ll have real ownership across UA, creative, martech, and measurement. This is not a channel manager role — it’s a multi-discipline growth operator role with a clear path to director

• You’ll work with a small, senior team that moves fast and makes real decisions. No layers of approval — the VP is your skip and the CMO is one level above that

• Part of Crypto.com — a global platform with the resources and ambition to build a category-defining product, and the speed and autonomy of a startup growth team

• Global remit — the markets you open and the playbooks you build will define how we scale internationally, not just in one country

Our Compliance Governance team is responsible for ensuring that our organization complies with applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards. You will be part of the core compliance team in establishing policies & advisory, procedures, and controls to monitor and enforce compliance, and play a critical role to mitigate regulatory risks.


About the role
We are seeking an experienced, hands-on strategic and operational leader to head the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) globally across every jurisdiction where Crypto.com operates. This role owns the end-to-end global financial crime transaction monitoring and investigation lifecycle, functioning as an integrated process chain spanning strategy, policy and procedure design, transaction monitoring rules design and management, transaction monitoring technology, Level 1 quality and SLA governance, Level 2 complex investigations, risk mitigation decisions, and SAR/STR filings across sanctions, AML/CFT, fraud, and complex fiat/crypto typologies.
You will set the global strategy, policies, and implementation procedures; continuously adapt the program to evolving financial crime risks; and assess Crypto.com’s overall transactional financial crime risk posture. Combining deep financial crime expertise with rigorous operational and process discipline, you will directly lead the global rules design, transaction monitoring, investigations, and SARs teams across North America, EMEA, and APAC, while exercising functional oversight over Level 1 alert operations by setting their procedures, monitoring their SLAs, and governing their output quality. You will own our transaction monitoring platforms, maintain real-time operational dashboards, and remain directly involved in complex casework, data analysis, and written work product. Additionally, the role includes interfacing with regulators during examinations and supporting law enforcement and financial intelligence unit engagements. Reporting to the SVP, Compliance in the US, you will partner closely with regional compliance teams, Operations, Data, and Product leadership to keep Crypto.com’s defenses ahead of emerging threats.


Key Responsibilities
Global FIU Strategy & Operating Model

• Define and own the multi-year global FIU strategy, target operating model, and investigative standards, aligned to the firm’s licensing footprint, product roadmap, and regulatory risk appetite.

• Manage the full transactional financial crime process chain, from rule design and alert generation through triage, escalation, investigation, risk mitigation, and SAR/STR reporting, ensuring global consistency with appropriate local tailoring.

• Continuously assess Crypto.com’s overall financial crime posture from a transactional risk perspective, proactively adapting rules, workflows, and controls to evolving money laundering, sanctions evasion, fraud, and terrorist financing typologies.

• Chair the global transaction monitoring Committee; arbitrate cross-regional conflicts on investigative approach, thresholds, and escalation to senior management.

• Own the global FIU budget, headcount plan, vendor strategy (blockchain analytics, case management, data providers), and capacity forecasting across regions.

Transaction Monitoring Tooling, Rules Design & Operational Governance

• Own the firm’s global transaction monitoring tools, blockchain analytics platforms, and case management systems, partnering with Engineering, Data Science, and Product to design, tune, validate, and optimize rule sets and detection logic.

• Exercise functional oversight of Level 1 alert operations, setting their standard operating procedures (SOPs), defining escalation criteria, monitoring SLA posture, and governing disposition quality.

• Establish, track, and enforce strict operational SLAs across all tiers of alert review, investigation, and regulatory filing; ensure executive and operational dashboards are accurate, real-time, and actively used to manage throughput, backlog, and risk.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Payments Officer, you will be the go-to person for our clients’ payment needs – from deposits and withdrawals to credits and account balances. You will process and report on transactions, help manage our payment provider relationships and support the external cashier where needed.

At heart, this is a people role. You will be a warm, reassuring point of contact for our clients, using your excellent customer service skills to keep them informed and at ease – whatever the question. Working closely with teams across the business, you will also spot, troubleshoot and resolve payment issues quickly, making sure every client enjoys a smooth, reliable experience.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Respond to client payment queries, providing clear and accurate information on transactions and account balances.

• Process client deposits, withdrawals and credits promptly and accurately.

• Record all financial transactions correctly across the company’s systems.

• Monitor client bank accounts for incoming and outgoing transactions.

• Investigate issues with automated transactions and work with internal and external teams to resolve them.

• Process client bonuses in line with company procedures.

• Keep client financial information accurate and up to date.

• Maintain thorough records and make them available when required.

• Prepare reports on accounts, transactions and wider payment activity.

• Work with other departments to resolve day-to-day operational issues.

• Support the smooth running of integrated payment services.

• Liaise with payment service providers (PSPs) on technical issues and missing transactions.

• Monitor communication channels and respond promptly to internal and external messages.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

• A warm, people-first manner and excellent customer service skills – this is the heart of the role.

• Excellent spoken and written English.

• Strong organisational and communication skills.

• Sharp attention to detail.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Good working knowledge of Microsoft 365.

• Previous experience in payments or working with PSPs is an advantage.

EDUCATION

• A university degree in Accounting, Business Administration or a related field is desirable.

WORKING HOURS – PLEASE READ

This role does not follow standard office hours. Please make sure this working pattern suits you before applying.

• Evening and night shifts: this is a shift-based role covering evening and night shifts, including late-night and overnight hours.

• Weekends and public holidays: payments run around the clock, so shifts may fall on weekends and public holidays on a rota basis.

• Changing patterns: shift times and rotas may change in line with business needs, and you may be asked to move between evening and night shifts.

• Daytime training: your initial training will take place during daytime core hours, so you can get to know the team and our systems before moving onto your regular shifts.

• Excellent command of the English language, both written and verbal.

• Lead complex product initiatives from discovery through delivery, proactively shaping roadmap priorities and driving meaningful outcomes.

• Design engaging experiences and interactive storytelling that bring personality to the trader journey.

• Partner closely with Product and Engineering to influence decisions, navigate technical constraints, and ship high-quality experiences quickly.

• Build scalable visual patterns, interaction principles, and design frameworks that empower the broader team to deliver at a higher standard.

• Own strategic conversations with executive stakeholders, advocate for design direction, and mentor designers through hands-on leadership.

• 8 + years of experience in product, visual, or interaction design, with a portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual craft and strong product thinking.

• Proven ability to independently lead complex product initiatives from discovery through implementation, taking ownership without waiting for direction.

• Deep expertise in typography, color, composition, visual storytelling, interaction design, and translating brand expression into digital products.

• Proven experience designing engaging, interactive experiences that bring together product functionality, brand expression, motion, gamification, and visual storytelling.

• Proven experience collaborating across Product Design, Brand, and Marketing to establish creative direction and deliver cohesive experiences across digital touchpoints.

• Experience creating scalable visual systems, reusable interaction patterns, and frameworks that elevate design quality across teams.

• Strong proficiency in Figma and high-fidelity prototyping, with motion design, animation, and gamification experience highly valued.

• Demonstrated ability to independently own executive-level conversations, influence product and creative direction, and align cross-functional stakeholders.

• Strong collaboration with Product, Engineering, Brand, and Marketing, with the ability to move between strategic decisions and hands-on execution.

• A passion for mentoring designers, raising visual standards, and taking accountability for shipped product outcomes.

• This is an individual contributor role requiring hands-on design execution, cross-functional leadership, and mentorship without direct people management responsibilities.

Company Culture & Perks

As a Senior Investigator in Coinbase’s Financial Intelligence Unit within Compliance (2LoD), you’ll help drive Coinbase’s financial crime investigations capability across multiple jurisdictions. This team leads complex reactive and proactive investigations, develops intelligence on emerging typologies and risk patterns, and translates investigative insights into high-quality SAR/STR decisions, escalations and programme improvements. You’ll work on high-impact matters across Coinbase’s global platform, partnering closely with MLROs, local compliance teams, operations teams and cross functional stakeholders to protect Coinbase and its customers from financial crime.

What you’ll do:

• Own end-to-end investigations into complex AML/CFT matters, from alert review or referral, through case development, disposition and SAR/STR submission to relevant FIUs.

• Conduct delegated MLRO reviews of Suspicious Transaction Reports and Suspicious Activity Reports prior to filing, ensuring accuracy, quality and regulatory defensibility.

• Lead proactive investigations, using transaction data, on-chain activity, trading behaviour and cross functional intelligence and OSINT to identify emerging typologies, threat patterns and high-risk activity.

• Develop actionable intelligence from casework and analytics to inform escalations, regulatory reporting, control enhancements and improvements to detection and investigation workflows.

• Partner internally with Country MLROs, local compliance teams, operations teams and other stakeholders on high-risk matters, information sharing and investigation strategy.

• Partner with law enforcement agencies and external stakeholders on suspicious activity reporting, information requests, and intelligence sharing.

• Support investigation quality through case review, structured feedback and contributions to policies, procedures, training and programme maturity.

Required Skills and Experience:

• 4+ years conducting and reviewing complex crypto financial crime investigations including experience across a range of products such as retail and institutional transfers, spot trading and derivatives.

• Experience preparing, reviewing and filing SARs/STRs with strong understanding of multi-jurisdiction AML/CTF regulatory obligations and reporting expectations.

• Demonstrated ability to perform data-driven investigations using SQL, blockchain analytics tools and other research techniques to extract investigative insights, identify suspicious behaviour and develop defensible conclusions.

• Strong investigative judgement and the ability to produce clear, structured long-form reports tailored to technical, compliance, leadership, and cross-functional audiences.

• Experience identifying financial crime typologies, contributing to proactive investigations and turning investigative findings into programme or control improvements.

• Utilises generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

About IG
IG Group is a publicly traded FTSE 100 FinTech company running mobile, web and desktop platforms that help clients trade shares, leveraged products, futures & options and crypto.
Role Purpose
Drive revenue growth through excellent customer service across all high value customers, deliver exceptional client experience for IG's premium client segment through proactive relationship management, strategic client development across a dedicated portfolio of high-value traders and investors. You will increase and maintain activity within the HNWI client book by building long-term, trust-based relationships and delivering bespoke service.
Success Profile
The ideal candidate is a results-driven relationship manager who can balance high-touch client service with ambitious revenue targets. You are comfortable with face-to-face meeting, event hosting and building lasting client communities, while maintaining strict compliance with execution-only trading regulations. Strong commercial acumen and a solid financial services background are fundamental.
Key Responsibilities
Revenue Growth
• Build and grow your client book
• Drive quarterly revenue growth through strategic client engagement, and trigger trading appetite among existing clients through timely, relevant conversations
• Reactivate dormant clients through special offers, event invitations and retention calls
• Analyse client profitability and prioritise engagement accordingly; structure rebate agreements and pricing that optimise lifetime value
• Track conversion metrics, product adoption rates and revenue per client
Product Expansion
• Identify natural cross-sell and up-sell opportunities aligned to each client's objectives and trading style
• Deliver demos, webinars and interactive content that demonstrate value
• Identify the most appropriate client solutions (not just quick wins) to drive trust and long-term relationships
Outstanding Client Care
• Conduct needs-based discovery to understand client goals and growth potential, using effective questioning, handling objections proactively and always securing a commitment to the next step
• Develop personalised engagement strategies for each client, using multi-channel outreach (in person, phone, video, digital) tailored to client sophistication
• Deliver market insights and strategic guidance that build credibility, using market events and volatility for strategic client conversations
• Stay informed on market and competitor news and use it to enhance the client's trading experience
• Resolve client issues quickly, leveraging relationships across IG (dealing desk, credit, payments and other teams) and keeping clients informed of progress rather than being solely reactive
• Solicit client feedback, share it with the appropriate teams, record key information in the CRM (Salesforce) and track updates through to follow-up with the client
Collaboration
• Work closely with Customer Support and wider teams, sharing client insights and supporting high value clients with complex cases.
• Maintain strict compliance and attention to detail in all client interactions, records and bookings
Essential Requirements
Experience
• Minimum 2 years in premium client management within financial services, with leveraged trading products expertise (CFDs, forex, derivatives)
• Proven track record managing high-net-worth client relationships
• Quantifiable results in revenue generation and client retention, including meeting or exceeding targets in competitive environments
• Experience working in regulated financial environments
• Bonus: ability to bring an existing client network
Qualifications
• Multilingual fluency would be an advantage
Core Competencies
• Revenue-focused mindset with proven ability to meet and exceed targets
• Consultative selling: uncovering needs through discovery questioning and positioning solutions aligned to client objectives
• Commercial acumen: connecting client goals to revenue outcomes and understanding what drives trading volume and product adoption
• Analytical mindset for client profiling and prioritisation
• Exceptional communication skills for explaining complex financial products and building credibility with high-net-worth individuals
• Strong organisational skills: coordinating multiple client relationships while maintaining quality standards and planned use of time
• Self-motivated, with the ability to work under pressure and against challenging KPIs
Behaviours and Culture
Alignment with IG Europe culture: Clarity, Pace, Ownership, with a balanced focus on both results and people.
Results
• Be accountable, do what you say and show tenacity
• Show self-discipline, initiative and a proactive mindset towards collaborative problem solving
• Fix problems as soon as you encounter them, or escalate where necessary
Respect
• Treat clients and colleagues fairly and courteously, with integrity and honesty
• Adapt communication style to enhance others' experience and maximise opportunity
• Listen to understand; show resilience, ask for support and admit mistakes while identifying solutions
• Collaborate with a "One team" ethos and empathy for different departments' and clients' needs
Compensation Structure
• Base salary
• Competitive performance-based commission structure for acquisition of new clients
• Quarterly bonus linked to performance vs. targets and individual KPIs
• Comprehensive benefits package

• Ability to de-escalate difficult situations professionally

• Flexibility and adaptability to work effectively across rotational shifts
• Collaborative approach while maintaining individual productivity

• Ability to master complex financial products and trading concepts rapidly

• Previous experience with financial products, derivatives, or trading platforms

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout,  xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.




THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We are looking for a Security GRC Lead to own security governance, risk, and compliance across Payward's acquisitions. You will be the accountable owner for bringing each acquired company from its own control environment into ours, working with the M&A Technology Team from diligence through to either full platform migration or steady-state coverage under our central program.

Payward acquires and integrates companies continuously, across multiple jurisdictions and regulatory regimes. Every target arrives with its own controls, its own maturity level and its own audit history, and every one enters our financial statement audit scope on a timeline set by the deal rather than by readiness. Today that work competes for the same people who run controls for the parent company. This role exists so that it has a dedicated owner.

This is a build role to uphold the repeatable process for assessing an acquired company against our security baseline, mapping its controls into our compliance frameworks,and setting remediation milestones a newly acquired team can realistically hit. You will then run it, deal after deal, and you are accountable for the work getting done.

 


THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Assess each acquisition target against Payward's security baseline, during diligence where deal timelines allow and immediately post-close otherwise

 - Map the acquired company's existing controls to Payward's control framework, and identify gaps against the external frameworks the entity falls under once in scope

 - Score control maturity at the entity level and document the basis for each score

 - Define remediation milestones that are achievable for the acquired team's size and maturity, sequenced by risk reduction rather than by framework order

 - Track milestones to closure and report status to Security GRC leadership and the M&A Technology Team

 - Recommend the endpoint for each entity: full migration onto Payward platforms, or uplift to a maturity level the central program can absorb

 - Load acquired-entity risks into the enterprise risk register and keep them current

 - Prepare acquired entities for inclusion in external audit scope, including evidence collection and walkthrough support

 - Act as the Security GRC point of contact for acquired-entity leadership, finance, and internal audit

 - Maintain policy coverage for acquired entities, including building entity-specific policy libraries where the parent policy set does not apply cleanly

 - Feed recurring findings back into the diligence process, so later deals are assessed against known patterns

 - Document the onboarding process so that it is repeatable and not dependent on one person

 


WHAT WILL YOU DO

 - Target Assessment
   
   - Review target security posture during diligence: control environment, identity and access management, infrastructure, third-party dependencies, and prior audit or examination history
   
   - Produce a written assessment of each target against the Payward security baseline, separating the risks that matter to the deal from those that matter to steady-state operations
   
   - Give the M&A Technology Team and deal sponsors a clear read on what integration will cost in control remediation terms

 - Control Mapping and Framework Onboarding
   
   - Map acquired controls to Payward's framework and to the external frameworks the entity becomes subject to
   
   - Identify which parent-company controls extend to the entity as they are, which need an entity-specific variant, and which have no equivalent at all
   
   - Build the entity's policy library where the parent policy set does not cover it

 - Remediation and Milestones
   
   - Set milestones the acquired team can meet, each with a date, an owner, and a stated risk reduction
   
   - Sequence work so that the highest-risk gaps close first rather than the easiest ones
   
   - Run the cadence for tracking remediation and escalating overdue or material risks Prepare proposed risk acceptances, including the rationale and compensating controls, and present them to leadership for decision

 - Program Integration
   
   - Prepare entities for external audit inclusion and support fieldwork
   
   - Keep acquired-entity risk visible in the enterprise risk register and in Security GRC reporting
   
   - Hand each entity over to central GRC coverage once its maturity supports it, with the handover documented
   
   - Integrate 3rd parties and vendors into Payward


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 5-7+ years in security governance, IT risk, or compliance, including regulated financial services, fintech, or virtual asset environments

 - Direct experience onboarding an acquired company into an existing controls or compliance program. This is the core of the role

 - Working knowledge of SOX/ICFR IT general controls and what external auditors accept as evidence

 - Experience with at least two of ISO 27001, SOC 1, SOC 2, and PCI DSS, including mapping controls across frameworks

 - Ability to assess control maturity and set remediation plans the receiving team completes, including teams below Payward's maturity level

 - Hands-on delivery: you write the scope, collect the evidence, and close gaps yourself when needed

 - Sound judgment on priorities with incomplete information, and the sense to escalate decisions that need leadership

 - Ability to build working relationships with control owners in IAM, infrastructure, and engineering

 - Ability to translate control gaps into risk language that deal teams and executives can act on

 - Strong project management across cross-functional, distributed teams

 - Preferred
   
   - CISA, CRISC, CISM, CISSP, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer
   
   - M&A or post-merger technology integration experience
   
   - Familiarity with PKM

 


WHY THIS ROLE

 - You will own a domain end to end rather than supporting someone else's. There is no incumbent process and no one else doing this work today

 - Acquisitions are one of the fastest-moving parts of the business, and security integration sits on the critical path for each one

 - You will work directly with deal teams, acquired-company leadership, external auditors, and Security GRC leadership, with visibility into how acquisitions are evaluated and closed

 - Payward is preparing for public company reporting, which means the controls you put in place at acquired entities are the ones external auditors will test

 - The scope of this role grows with the acquisition pipeline, across jurisdictions and regulatory regimes

 - You will join a remote-first, international team

 - Own growth in viral, KOL- and creator-referred new transacting users (NTUs). Set aggressive NTU targets backed by a credible growth model, then beat them. Build and scale sharing, referral, and creator systems that drive 10x, then 50x growth while hitting payback targets.

 - Build sharing people find useful. Create natural reasons to pass on product value, and referral programs with modeled payback incentives, and without relying on aggressive incentives to hit targets. Make both work for the sender, recipient, and business.

 - Own the audience-to-customer journey. Build and test paths from recommendations and creator audiences to product value and a first transaction. Partner with the teams that own onboarding and core product experiences on shared journeys.

 - Own Consumer features and updates for the KOL Platform. Set the Consumer roadmap, ship features and ongoing improvements, and make measurement and commercial tools trustworthy and easy to use. Work with the teams that own KOL and affiliate relationships.

 - Build creator tools across Kraken’s app and web. Help creators, key opinion leaders (KOLs), and power referrers invite their followers and turn their audiences into valuable new transacting customers. Understand their different motivations and build with core product teams.

 - Make acquisition economics work. Own acquisition cost and gross-margin payback against clear targets, including fully loaded incentive, partner, operating, and fraud costs. Use downstream retention and revenue to judge what deserves more investment.

 - Increase virality per new transacting user and per returning user. Test ways to improve send conversion, invites per sender, and invite-to-first-transaction conversion. Improve repeat sharing and loop speed, and prove the gains create incremental valuable new transacting customers.

 - Build measurement you can trust. Validate instrumentation, define hypotheses and guardrails, and run tests that can detect meaningful effects. Separate attributed activity from incremental growth, interpret uncertainty honestly, and check that gains persist as you scale.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - You’ve personally built a product, tool, feature, or experience that spread beyond its initial audience. You can explain why it spread, your contribution, and how it acquired valuable customers.

 - Repeated success beating acquisition targets through referrals, product virality, or creator-led growth. Show the baseline, target, result, timeframe, component rates you improved, and your personal contribution. Bring evidence the gains lasted.

 - Strong growth product sense. You understand sharing psychology and the different motivations of customers, creators, KOLs, and power referrers. You combine customer research, creative product instincts, and strong UX and copy to give people a reason to participate.

 - Analytical independence. You independently investigate behavior with SQL and product analytics, validate instrumentation, and build funnel, cohort, and growth models.

 - Experimentation and commercial judgment. You design reliable tests, interpret uncertainty honestly, and distinguish attribution from incremental growth. You understand acquisition cost and payback, including downstream retention, revenue, and fully loaded incentive and fraud costs.

 - Senior ownership and hands-on execution. You set strategy, make hard priority calls, align teams without relying on reporting lines, and deliver autonomously. You use AI and working prototypes to turn original ideas into experiences people can try.




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience building self-service creator or affiliate tools, revenue-share systems, or reliable partner payouts.

 - Consumer fintech, crypto, payments, or experience designing financial promotions and fraud controls.

 - Experience adapting growth journeys across markets, cultures, and regulatory environments.

Monitor delivery and diagnose issues including limited learning, low delivery, audience saturation, frequency pressure, placement inefficiency and conversion-signal weakness.

Maintain account hygiene through naming conventions, labels, URL and UTM checks, disapproval checks, pre-launch QA, change logs and routine health reviews.

Identify and implement optimisation opportunities independently within agreed commercial and compliance guardrails.
Audience strategy and analysis

Build and maintain prospecting, retargeting and lifecycle audience structures aligned to campaign objectives and customer journey stages.
•
Use approved first-party, website, app-engagement and platform audiences, including custom audiences, lookalike or equivalent expansion and automated audience products where appropriate.

Maintain accurate exclusions and suppression logic to reduce overlap, protect prospecting activity and avoid inappropriate retargeting.

Analyse audience performance by market, funnel stage, creative and placement; identify saturation, weak quality, scale constraints and expansion opportunities.

Turn audience findings into clear actions across targeting, exclusions, budget allocation, creative briefs and campaign structure.
Budget pacing and forecasting
•
Monitor spend against approved plans by platform, market and campaign, maintaining an accurate pacing view.

Flag over- or underspend risk early, explain the cause and recommend corrective action.

Reallocate budget within agreed guardrails based on performance, delivery opportunity, downstream quality and business priority.

Provide short-term forecasts and month-end outlooks, clearly stating assumptions and delivery risks.

Escalate material budget, tracking, policy or inventory constraints before they affect delivery.

•
Analyse performance by creative concept, hook, message, proposition, format, duration, placement, call to action and variation where data is available.

Identify winning and underperforming patterns, creative fatigue and gaps in platform-native asset coverage.

Convert findings into clear test hypotheses and prioritised recommendations rather than descriptive commentary.

Brief the creative team on new concepts, iterations and platform-native variations, including objective, audience, insight, hook, message, format, required versions and success metric.

Track assets from briefing through launch and post-test analysis, documenting learning for future iterations and localisation.

•
Monitor post-click conversion performance using available analytics, segmented by platform, campaign, audience, creative, device, market and landing page where useful.
•
Identify likely friction, message mismatch, weak journey alignment, broken links, tracking gaps or page-performance issues that may suppress conversion.

Check destination URLs, deep links, app-store routes, UTMs and campaign-to-page alignment as part of launch and ongoing QA.

Brief CRO, web, product or app teams on evidence-based improvement and testing opportunities; this role supports analysis and briefing rather than owning the full CRO roadmap or development.

Use public platform ad-transparency and creative-discovery resources, alongside market observations, to identify material shifts and testable themes.

Turn observations into practical recommendations for messaging, creative formats, audience hypotheses, landing pages or structured tests.

Define a clear hypothesis, control and variant, primary success metric, guardrails and expected decision before launch.

Configure platform experiments or other agreed test designs, validate setup and protect data quality during the test.

Interpret results carefully, distinguishing directional evidence from conclusive findings and documenting limitations.
•
Record outcomes, decisions and next actions so learning can be reused across platforms and markets.
•
Support conversion-lift, brand-lift and incrementality studies through setup, QA and data collection under the direction of the paid social lead or measurement team.
Tracking and measurement - web and app
•
Maintain working knowledge of platform pixels/tags, event configuration and server-side or conversion API concepts relevant to Meta, TikTok and X.

Validate conversion events and diagnose broken, missing, duplicated or misfiring signals; deep engineering implementation remains with Analytics or MarTech.

Run weekly analysis for assigned markets and identify key performance drivers, blockers, risks and opportunities independently.

Produce concise reporting covering performance versus target, budget pacing, funnel and quality signals, material changes and planned optimisations.

Provide actionable creative, audience, placement, platform and landing-page insights with clear owners and next actions.

Use spreadsheets confidently for pivots, lookups, reconciliations and large platform exports.
•
Maintain clear documentation for tests, budget moves, structural changes and material optimisation decisions.

Execute and optimise multi-market and multi-language campaigns with appropriate consideration of local audience behaviour, creative conventions, copy and compliance nuance.

Coordinate translations and local validation where needed; do not rely on unreviewed machine translation for market-facing copy.

Turn around agreed ad hoc requests to deadline while protecting planned priorities.

QA agency output in assigned markets against agreed build, tracking, creative, compliance and reporting standards.

Escalate conflicts in market priority, resource or deadline risk promptly.

Monitor and resolve ad and asset disapprovals, escalating policy or legal questions through the correct internal route.

Follow approved claims, disclaimers, targeting restrictions, landing-page requirements and market rules, maintaining an auditable record of material changes.

Apply disciplined pre- and post-launch QA covering naming, objective, audience, exclusions, placements, budgets, schedule, optimisation event, URLs, tracking, creative and policy status.
Ways of working

Communicate proactively with the line manager on progress, blockers, decisions and deadline risk.

Organise concurrent market and platform priorities effectively and deliver to agreed timelines.

Collaborate with creative, CRO/web, app, analytics, MarTech, compliance and agency partners while retaining clear ownership of paid social execution.

2+ years of hands-on paid social experience, ideally in a high-competition or complex vertical.
•
Proven day-to-day campaign delivery across Meta, with practical hands-on execution across TikTok and X.
•
Experience managing both web and app acquisition campaigns, including optimisation to conversion and app events.
•
Ability to build, QA, launch, optimise and troubleshoot campaigns independently across concurrent markets.
•
Strong audience-management capability across prospecting, retargeting, first-party/custom audiences, expansion, exclusions and saturation analysis.
•
Ability to analyse creative performance and brief new concepts, iterations and platform-native variations to a creative team.
•
Practical budget pacing and short-term forecasting skills, including early identification of over- or underspend risk.
•
Experience designing and interpreting structured tests across creative, audiences, placements, optimisation and campaign setup.
•
Ability to assess landing-page and post-click performance and brief evidence-based improvements without requiring full CRO ownership.

Working knowledge of paid social conversion tracking, event validation and troubleshooting across web and app.

Strong performance-analysis and written-reporting skills, with the ability to convert data into prioritised actions.

Disciplined QA and governance approach covering naming, URLs, tracking, audiences, budgets, creative, policy status and change logging.

Clear written communication for reporting upwards and briefing internal teams, agencies and external partners.

Proactive workload management, ownership of deadlines and early escalation of blockers or risk.

Experience managing multi-market and multi-language paid social accounts.

AppsFlyer or equivalent MMP experience, including app-event mapping, deep links, attribution windows and SKAdNetwork concepts.

GA4, Looker Studio, Power BI or comparable analytics and reporting experience.

Experience supporting conversion-lift, brand-lift or incrementality studies and interpreting results appropriately.

Join FxPro: a leading international fintech company. Be a part of our expanding international team, with offices in Limassol, London, Nassau, Dubai, and Yerevan. FxPro boasts a diverse workforce of over 600 employees representing 50 nationalities, making it an exciting and dynamic workplace. At FxPro, we see each team member as an integral part of our success story.

We are looking for a Payment Partnerships Manager with experience in payments within the CFD, forex, online trading or a similar high-risk industry. The successful candidate will be responsible for analysing competitor payment offerings, identifying opportunities to improve our payment capabilities, and building strong relationships with payment service providers (PSPs), acquirers, banks and local payment providers across key markets.

The role combines competitor research, payment analysis, provider sourcing, relationship management and the testing and implementation of new payment solutions. The ideal candidate will be proactive, commercially minded and well-connected within the payments industry.

Responsibilities

• Research and monitor competitors across the CFD, forex, online trading and other relevant high-risk sectors to get full understanding of payment methods, providers, market coverage and overall payment offering

• Review and test competitor and market payment solutions where possible, identifying strengths, weaknesses, gaps

• Build and maintain a structured database comparing our payment offering with competitors, including payment methods, geographic coverage, providers, user experience and other relevant metrics

• Identify and research potential PSPs, acquirers, banks and local alternative payment providers across target markets

• Initiate contact, establish relationships and manage communications with prospective providers, from initial outreach through commercial negotiations and onboarding

• Attend relevant payments, fintech, forex and online trading events to meet new providers, expand the company's network and identify potential partnership opportunities

• Request and compare proposals, processing fees, transaction limits, reserves, settlement terms and other commercial conditions

• Evaluate providers based on market coverage, payment methods, commercial viability, technical capabilities, operational reliability and regulatory requirements

• Coordinate due diligence, payment testing and onboarding with internal teams and external providers, supporting the launch of new payment solutions

Requirements

• At least 3 years of experience in payments, PSP partnerships, payment operations or business development

• Established background CFD, forex, banking, iGaming, crypto or a similar high-risk industry

• An existing network of PSPs, acquirers, banks and alternative payment providers is highly desirable

• Good understanding of card acquiring, local payment methods, e-wallets, bank transfers and payment processing

• Strong research and analytical skills, with the ability to assess competitor offerings and identify market opportunities

• Experience in provider sourcing, relationship management and commercial negotiations

• Strong organisational skills and the ability to maintain accurate databases and manage multiple opportunities simultaneously

• Excellent written and verbal English; additional languages are an advantage

Interview steps

• Screening call with recruiter (~30 minutes)

• Technical interview with Chief Of Operations

Our benefits

• Competitive compensation package

• Flexibility of remote work

• All the equipment you need

• 21 days off and 10 sick leaves annually

• Enjoyable break during Public Cyprus Holidays

• Seasoned senior-level team with ample opportunities for professional growth in an international setting

Job TitleProgramme Delivery Lead: Cloud (AWS) Transformation

Job Description
Programme Delivery Lead, Infrastructure & Operations
Location: London, UK
Employment type: Permanent, Full Time
Reporting into: Head of Platform Product & Enablement

About IG Group

IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.4m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses.

The bar is high – bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next.

Join us at IG – the future gets built here.

Your role

As part of our Cloud transformation strategy, this Programme Delivery Lead would be responsible for the successful planning, coordination, and delivery of Infrastructure & Operations deliverables in support of IG's wider Transformation programme. This role acts as the critical link between Product Managers, Enablement teams, and external delivery partners, ensuring that infrastructure and operational workstreams are delivered on time, to quality, and in a way that enables the broader transformation agenda to succeed.

This is a highly cross functional role requiring strong stakeholder management skills, the ability to influence without direct authority, and clear, confident communication across technical and non-technical audiences at all levels of the organisation.

Your role in the team:

Programme & Delivery Management

Own planning and delivery of I&O deliverables from start to finish across transformation programmes, ensuring alignment with priorities set by Product Managers and overall programme milestones.
• Build and maintain robust delivery plans, tracking dependencies, risks, and issues across multiple concurrent I&O workstreams.
• Proactively identify delivery risks and blockers, escalating early and driving mitigation actions to keep programmes on track.
• Ensure deliverables meet agreed quality, governance, and compliance standards before sign-off.

Cross Functional Collaboration
• Partner closely with Product Managers to align infrastructure and operational delivery with product roadmaps and business priorities.
• Work with Enablement teams to ensure teams are equipped, trained, and supported to adopt new infrastructure, tooling, and ways of working.
• Act as a central coordination point across technical delivery teams, ensuring consistent understanding of scope, priorities, and timelines.

External Partner Management

• Manage relationships with external delivery partners and vendors, ensuring contracted deliverables are met to agreed scope, cost, and timeline.
• Hold partners accountable to delivery commitments through structured governance, regular reviews, and clear performance tracking.
• Act as an escalation point for partner related delivery issues, resolving conflicts and course correcting quickly where needed.

Stakeholder Management & Communication

• Build strong, trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across the business, translating complex technical delivery into clear, business relevant updates.
• Provide regular, transparent reporting on programme status, risks, and dependencies to leadership and steering groups.
• Act as a clear and confident communicator, able to tailor messaging for technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior leadership alike.
• Foster a collaborative culture, ensuring all parties, internal teams and external partners, remain aligned and engaged throughout delivery.

Governance & Continuous Improvement

• Establish and maintain appropriate programme governance, ensuring decisions are made at the right level and documented clearly.
• Identify opportunities to improve delivery processes, ways of working, and cross team collaboration.
• Support the maturation of I&O's contribution to transformation programmes, embedding lessons learned into future delivery.

What you'll need:

Key Skills & Experience

• Proven track record leading complex, multi stakeholder programmes within an Infrastructure & Operations or technology delivery context.
• Experience supporting large scale transformation initiatives.
• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to engage and influence at all levels, including senior leadership.
• Experience managing external partners and vendors, including contractual and performance accountability.
• Excellent communication skills, written, verbal, and presentational, with the ability to simplify complexity for varied audiences.
• Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, comfortable managing multiple concurrent workstreams under time pressure.
• Familiarity with programme and project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid) and associated tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, MS Project).
• A collaborative, solutions focused mindset with strong problem solving ability.

Desirable
• Experience within [financial services / trading / relevant sector].
• Relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, Prince2, Agile/Scrum).
• Prior experience working directly with Product and Enablement functions in a matrixed organisation.

Behavioural Competencies
• Clear, confident communicator across all levels
• Strong relationship builder and influencer
• Highly organised with excellent attention to detail
• Resilient under pressure, adaptable to shifting priorities
• Accountable and outcome focused

The Perks:

Competitive salary
• Flexible Benefits Package on top of your salary (12%)
• Private medical cover for you and your family
• Life insurance

About the job
As a regulated investment services provider, knowing our clients is fundamental to how Saxo operates. It enables us to serve clients appropriately while identifying and managing potential financial crime and integrity risks.

As a KYC Analyst in our Antwerp office, you will play an important role in onboarding new clients and reviewing existing relationships. You will investigate client profiles, assess source of wealth and source of funds, conduct enhanced due diligence and determine whether identified risks are acceptable within Saxo’s policies and risk appetite.
This is not a box-ticking role. You will need to connect information from different sources, distinguish between relevant and non-material findings and document clear, well-reasoned conclusions. At the same time, you will help ensure that legitimate clients can access Saxo’s investment services without unnecessary delays or friction.

You will work closely with colleagues across Financial Crime Prevention, the Belgian commercial organisation and Saxo’s international shared services. Together, you will deliver compliant and efficient onboarding and ongoing due diligence processes while maintaining a strong client experience.

Responsibilities
In this role, you will:
• Conduct KYC reviews for new and existing private, corporate and institutional clients in line with applicable AML requirements and Saxo’s internal policies.
• Investigate client ownership structures, source of wealth, source of funds, transaction-related information and other relevant risk indicators.
• Perform customer risk assessments and enhanced due diligence, documenting clear and well-supported conclusions in English.
• Identify, investigate and escalate potential AML, financial crime and integrity risks when further review or action is required.
• Communicate directly with clients to collect and clarify the information needed to complete KYC reviews.
• Collaborate with Relationship Managers, local KYC colleagues and international shared-service teams to ensure efficient onboarding and ongoing due diligence.
• Review the quality of work delivered by shared-service teams and provide practical guidance when improvements are needed.
• Identify recurring quality gaps and contribute to improving KYC controls, processes and ways of working.
• Support the review and implementation of Saxo’s AML policies, procedures and relevant regulatory requirements.

Your profile
You are an analytical and responsible KYC professional who is comfortable making decisions based on complex or incomplete information. You approach clients with professionalism and empathy, but you are also confident asking challenging questions when the situation requires it.

You can identify what is material from a risk perspective and translate your analysis into concise, structured and defensible KYC conclusions. You understand that strong KYC involves both protecting the organisation and providing legitimate clients with an efficient and professional experience.

We are looking for someone who brings:
• At least two years of experience in KYC, client due diligence, AML or a closely related regulatory environment
• Practical experience with client onboarding, ongoing due diligence, enhanced due diligence or customer risk assessments
• The ability to investigate complex client information and form clear, risk-based conclusions
• Experience working with private, corporate and/or institutional clients, which would be an advantage
• Fluency in Dutch and a strong command of English, both written and spoken
• Strong written communication skills and the ability to produce clear, structured and well-reasoned KYC reports in English
• A high level of integrity, sound professional judgement and confidence in escalating concerns when appropriate
• An accurate and efficient working style, including the resilience to manage changing priorities and periods of higher workload
• An interest in working in a digital-first banking environment and using modern software and AI-enabled tools responsibly to support analysis and efficiency

Your team and workplace
You will join a team of five KYC Analysts in Saxo’s Belgian branch. Our Antwerp office has approximately 30 employees who work together to serve more than 120,000 clients.
The local environment gives you the opportunity to take real ownership, work closely with decision-makers and see the direct impact of your work. At the same time, you will be part of an international organisation with colleagues and specialist teams across multiple countries.
You will be based in our office on the 18th floor in central Antwerp, within walking distance of the Meir and Antwerp Central Station, with views across the historic city centre.
